note: CD3pos: T lymphocytes — vertical band at high CD3 (CD3+), spanning a broad SSC-A range; the CD3-low cluster on the left is excluded. CD3 is bimodal — boundary set at the valley between the CD3- and CD3+ peaks.
tips: Positive selection of T cells on pre-gated Live singlet lymphocytes. CD3pos: CD3+ (pan-T marker). The y-axis SSC-A serves as a secondary sanity check — T cells sit in the canonical lymphocyte scatter range; CD3+ events with aberrantly high SSC would indicate granulocyte contamination or doublets that slipped through the upstream cleanup. CD3- events (B cells, NK cells, myeloid) are not annotated here because they are not the target of this panel (separate B-cell / Treg / DC panels cover those).
